"""Independent snapshot divergence audit; writes only to solver/diagnostics.

Centered cell-field diagnostics do not equal a staggered CT divergence.
Two consistent derivatives expose radial-quadrature sensitivity.
"""
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
folder = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
z = np.load(sorted(folder.glob("snapshot_*.npy"))[-1]).astype(float)
r = np.load(folder/"r_au.npy").astype(float)
theta = np.load(folder/"theta_rad.npy").astype(float)
phi = np.load(folder/"phi_rad.npy").astype(float)
nr, nt, nphi = z.shape[:3]
cfg = {}
for line in (folder/"run.cfg").read_text().splitlines():
    if "=" in line:
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        cfg[k.strip()] = v.strip()
rmin, rmax = float(cfg["rmin_au"]), float(cfg["rmax_au"])
rf = np.geomspace(rmin, rmax, nr+1) if cfg.get("radial_grid") == "log" else np.linspace(rmin, rmax, nr+1)
latmax = np.radians(float(cfg["latmax_deg"]))
tf = np.linspace(np.pi/2-latmax, np.pi/2+latmax, nt+1)
dp = 2*np.pi/nphi
st, ct = np.sin(theta)[None, :, None], np.cos(theta)[None, :, None]
sp, cp = np.sin(phi)[None, None, :], np.cos(phi)[None, None, :]
er = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(st*cp, st*sp, ct), axis=-1)
et = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(ct*cp, ct*sp, -st), axis=-1)
ep = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(-sp+0*st, cp+0*st, 0*st+0*sp), axis=-1)
B = z[..., 5, None]*er+z[..., 6, None]*et+z[..., 7, None]*ep
volume = ((rf[1:]**3-rf[:-1]**3)/3)[:, None, None]*(np.cos(tf[:-1])-np.cos(tf[1:]))[None, :, None]*dp
volume = np.broadcast_to(volume, z.shape[:3])
h = np.cbrt(volume)
bmag = np.linalg.norm(B, axis=-1)

# Independent spherical-derivative diagnostic. A radial B proportional to
# r^-2 has exactly zero radial contribution before round-off.
div_spherical = np.gradient(r[:, None, None]**2*z[..., 5], r, axis=0, edge_order=2)/r[:, None, None]**2
div_spherical += np.gradient(st*z[..., 6], theta, axis=1, edge_order=2)/(r[:, None, None]*st)
div_spherical += (np.roll(z[..., 7], -1, 2)-np.roll(z[..., 7], 1, 2))/(2*dp*r[:, None, None]*st)

# Cartesian integrated-face diagnostic, matching the solver in interior cells.
ar = .5*np.diff(tf)-.25*np.diff(np.sin(2*tf))
az = .5*np.diff(np.sin(tf)**2)
radial_area = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(
    rf[:, None, None]**2*ar[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*cp,
    rf[:, None, None]**2*ar[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*sp,
    rf[:, None, None]**2*az[None, :, None]*dp+0*cp), axis=-1)
w = .5*np.diff(rf**2)[:, None, None]*np.sin(tf)[None, :, None]
theta_area = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(
    w*np.cos(tf)[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*cp,
    w*np.cos(tf)[None, :, None]*2*np.sin(dp/2)*sp,
    -w*np.sin(tf)[None, :, None]*dp+0*cp), axis=-1)
phi_edges = np.arange(nphi)*dp
wp = .5*np.diff(rf**2)[:, None, None]*np.diff(tf)[None, :, None]
phi_area = np.stack(np.broadcast_arrays(-wp*np.sin(phi_edges), wp*np.cos(phi_edges), wp*0+0*phi_edges), axis=-1)
f_r = np.sum(.5*(B[:-1]+B[1:])*radial_area[1:-1], axis=-1)
f_t = np.sum(.5*(B[:, :-1]+B[:, 1:])*theta_area[:, 1:-1], axis=-1)
f_p = np.sum(.5*(B+np.roll(B, 1, axis=2))*phi_area, axis=-1)
div_fv = np.full_like(bmag, np.nan)
div_fv[1:-1, 1:-1] = (f_r[1:, 1:-1]-f_r[:-1, 1:-1]+f_t[1:-1, 1:]-f_t[1:-1, :-1]
                                  +np.roll(f_p[1:-1, 1:-1], -1, axis=2)-f_p[1:-1, 1:-1])/volume[1:-1, 1:-1]

probes = np.genfromtxt(folder/"probe.csv", delimiter=",", names=True)
comet = probes[probes["probe_id"] == 0][-1]
ri = int(np.argmin(abs(r-comet["r_au"])))
tj = int(np.argmin(abs(theta-(np.pi/2-comet["lat_rad"]))))
pk = int(np.argmin(abs(np.angle(np.exp(1j*(phi-comet["lon_rad"]))))))
regions = {}
interior = np.zeros_like(bmag, dtype=bool)
interior[1:-1, 1:-1] = True
regions["all_interior"] = interior
regions["r_gt_0p3_lat_lt_15deg"] = interior & (r[:, None, None] > .3) & (abs(np.pi/2-theta)[None, :, None] < np.radians(15))
regions["r_1p5_2p1_lat_lt_15deg"] = regions["r_gt_0p3_lat_lt_15deg"] & (r[:, None, None] > 1.5) & (r[:, None, None] < 2.1)
near = np.zeros_like(interior)
near[max(1,ri-1):min(nr-1,ri+2), max(1,tj-1):min(nt-1,tj+2)] = False
for kk in [(pk-1)%nphi, pk, (pk+1)%nphi]:
    near[max(1,ri-1):min(nr-1,ri+2), max(1,tj-1):min(nt-1,tj+2), kk] = True
regions["comet_neighborhood_3cubed"] = near
speed = np.linalg.norm(z[..., 1:4], axis=-1)*1000
rho = z[..., 0]*1e6*1.67262192369e-27
output = {"snapshot_day": float(comet["day"]), "comet_nearest_index": [ri, tj, pk], "methods": {}}
for method, div in [("cartesian_centered_face_FV", div_fv), ("spherical_scaled_radial_derivative", div_spherical)]:
    eps = h*abs(div)/(bmag+1e-30)
    # AU cancels between divB and v^2/r; B converted nT -> Tesla twice.
    force_ratio = bmag*abs(div)*1e-18*r[:, None, None]/(1.25663706212e-6*rho*speed**2)
"}}}
